hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC 8-K Item 1.02 termination-of-material-definitive-agreement events are normally negative, but when signal-day price action absorbs the termination versus SPY, the contract-overhang reset may create a next-open 10-trading-day default-off paper candidate.
causal_components: SEC submissions Item 1.02 exact item-code event
acceptance_rule: Gate 4: aggregate EV/PnL positive, no window EV/PnL regression, >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows, >=2 EV-improved windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution comparators beaten.

prediction.confidence_reason: Coverage scan found 272 raw and 43 absorption-qualified Item 1.02 rows across all three windows. The event has cleaner economics than generic 8-K labels, but contract termination can be real deterioration and recent SEC absorption scouts were weak.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing 8-K Item 1.02 event rows, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC 8-K Item 1.02 events, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC 8-K Item 1.02 contract-termination absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested structured Item 1.02 termination 8-K events plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.1190; aggregate PnL delta $+1,642.79; max drawdown drift +0.0002; 36 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping 8-K/A inclusion, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed Item 1.02 contract-termination absorption bundle fails, do not retry by sweeping 8-K/A inclusion, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
